commit.message: [client] Stop the service and UI before the NSIS installer extracts files (#8255)

verification.payload:
tree b6be7196005297dca2fe4803d80264bf54475c84
parent 73829c8d968bc2c0a8dd423449638ecc57134adf
author Bruno Mercier Costa <94469565+emrcbrn@users.noreply.github.com> 1792607868 +0200
committer GitHub <noreply@github.com> 1792607868 +0200

[client] Stop the service and UI before the NSIS installer extracts files (#8255)

files.patch:
@@ -198,6 +198,15 @@ FunctionEnd
 ######################################################################
 Section -MainProgram
     ${INSTALL_TYPE}
+    ; The previous uninstaller stops the service and the UI only when its uninstall key
+    ; is found and endpoint protection lets the unsigned uninstaller run. Extraction
+    ; fails on any exe that is still running.
+    DetailPrint "Stopping Netbird service..."
+    ExecWait '"$INSTDIR\${MAIN_APP_EXE}" service stop'
+    DetailPrint "Terminating ${UI_APP_NAME} process..."
+    ExecWait '"$SYSDIR\taskkill.exe" /im ${UI_APP_EXE}.exe /f'
+    ; Both return before the processes release their image files.
+    Sleep 3000
     # SetOverwrite ifnewer
     SetOutPath "$INSTDIR"
     !ifndef ARCH
